configuration_basis: Inherited model/reasoning values from the existing local CLI configuration, without modifying the real configuration. Native sessions use disposable client state and read-only OS sandbox.
auth_handling: Existing CLI auth is referenced by a private symlink; no authentication bytes were read or copied by the validation harness. Client-state directories are excluded from the archive.
raw_archive_policy: tools.rls_validation_support.run_step collects subprocess streams in memory and redacts them before first validation archive persistence; all digests bind archived bytes.
native_candidate_scope: Fresh per-skill installation, discovery from explicit invocation, no-skill control, exact missing-authority checks, no-write and installed runtime independence. Positive write/effect/final-confirmation lifecycle paths are not part of this native fixture.
acceptance: Independent review required; no accepted native cells.
actual_model_execution_metadata: Not independently recorded in the CLI JSON event streams; configured values are not an execution attestation.
